findings.F1: In a falling market, where a close sits in its 20-day high-low range ranks the next days' unusual move in the same direction, not against it. On the 3-day grid the Spearman correlation is +0.116 (673 cases) and on the 5-day grid +0.176 (401 cases). Closes in the bottom fifth of the range are followed by a 3-day unusual move of -1.54 % (t -2.3, 224 cases) and closes in the middle fifth by +1.27 % (t 1.97, 117 cases). This is continuation from the low edge, the opposite of the brief's pull back to the middle.
findings.F2: The continuation from the bottom of the range in falling markets holds across years. Closes at or below a quarter of the 20-day range are followed by a 3-day unusual move of -2.23 % in 2018 (162 cases, 47 days, day-pooled t -1.34) and -2.39 % in 2019 (71 cases, 31 days, t -1.57). Only 2020 points the other way, on a small sample: +9.1 % on 15 cases.
findings.F3: In a choppy market the 5-day unusual move rises steadily with the close's position in its 20-day range, so the brief's reversion is not there.
findings.F4: In choppy calm markets alone the samples are too small to read the brief's own cell. There are 50 cases on the 3-day grid in total. The 0.2-0.4 band is followed by -3.75 % (t -2.40, 8 cases), again a fall from the lower part of the range rather than a rebound.
findings.F5: In a falling market the tested rally fade shows only in its top bucket, which cannot be told from chance after clustering.
findings.F6: Two more patterns did not hold up or are already held.

ideas.idea: In a choppy market, the nearer a coin's close sits to the bottom of its 20-day high-low range, the larger its fall over the next 5 days; the nearer to the top, the larger its rise.
ideas.consequence: A trader in a range-bound coin should not buy closes near the range's low expecting a bounce, and has a reason to lean short there, the more so the closer to the low.
ideas.name: choppy range position continuation

ideas.idea: In a falling market, the nearer a coin's close sits to the bottom of its 20-day high-low range, the larger its further fall over the next 5 days.
ideas.consequence: In a coin that has been falling for two months, closes near the recent low are a reason to stay short or to refuse a long, the more so the nearer the low.
ideas.name: falling market range-low continuation
